entity.name: SaleOrderLine
entity.string: (SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT base_partner.partner_seq, ', ') FROM base_partner WHERE base_partner.id IN (SELECT stock_stock_move.partner FROM stock_stock_move WHERE stock_stock_move.id IN (SELECT stock_stock_move_line.stock_move FROM stock_stock_move_line WHERE stock_stock_move_line.id IN (SELECT stock_tracking_number.origin_stock_move_line FROM stock_tracking_number WHERE stock_tracking_number.id IN (SELECT supplychain_sale_order_line_lot.tracking_number FROM supplychain_sale_order_line_lot WHERE supplychain_sale_order_line_lot.sale_order_line = id)))))

entity.date: (SELECT min(stock_stock_move_line.dluo) FROM stock_stock_move_line WHERE stock_stock_move_line.id IN (SELECT stock_tracking_number.origin_stock_move_line FROM stock_tracking_number WHERE stock_tracking_number.id IN (SELECT supplychain_sale_order_line_lot.tracking_number FROM supplychain_sale_order_line_lot WHERE supplychain_sale_order_line_lot.sale_order_line = id)))
